name: orchestrate
description: Distributed Job Queue & Worker System (Orchestrate / JobQue)

scripts.build:shared: cd shared && npm ci && npm run pack
scripts.build:workers: cd workers && npm install ../shared/jobque-shared-1.0.0.tgz && npm run pack
scripts.build:api: cd api && npm install ../shared/jobque-shared-1.0.0.tgz ../workers/jobque-workers-1.0.0.tgz && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:workers && npm run build:api
scripts.docker:full: npm run docker:up && npm run docker:monitoring
scripts.migration:run: cd shared && npx typeorm-ts-node-commonjs migration:run -d src/database/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:generate: cd shared && npx typeorm-ts-node-commonjs migration:generate src/database/migrations/Migration -d src/database/data-source.ts
